title: Named Non-Owner Policy: Billing Plan Multiplier of the Retention on an Insured's Cancellation
content:
The billing plan of a Named Non-Owner Policy term, as recorded with the Installment Payment Plans product, sets a multiplier of the package's insured-cancellation retention percentage when the term is cancelled at the named insured's request; the multiplier is applied to that percentage before the reduction is taken.

| Billing plan of the term | Multiplier of the retention |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | 0.80 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | 0.90 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 0.90 |
| Two-Pay, Four-Pay, Six-Pay Direct Bill or any other plan | none |

*Hypothetical:* on a term billed on the Paid-in-Full Plan, a package retention percentage of 10.0 is multiplied by 0.80, giving 8.0; on a Two-Pay Plan term the 10.0 is left as it is.
